steps.message: I’ll inspect the local Maven configuration and GBFS usage under `/app`, then apply the dependency bump and adjust production code for the new API.

todos.content: Find Maven manifest entries for org.entur.gbfs:gbfs-java-model and current version
Update dependency version from 3.0.0 to 3.0.1 in production manifests/metadata
Locate production code using GBFS timezone APIs and update for 3.0.1
Run targeted Maven compile/tests to verify
